blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — What was meant to be a scenic mountain getaway ended in tragedy on Friday afternoon, Oct. 30, after a 19-year-old male hiker died from a lightning strike at a popular nature spot on Mt. Kilagas in Barangay Kiliog, Libona town. The victim, a resident of Macanahan, Cagayan de Oro City, had traveled by motorcycle with his 18-year-old girlfriend to view the scenic sea of clouds and mountain ranges at Cowboys Camp, an elevated site overlooking Bukidnon and Cagayan de Oro City.
